content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices, when utilized in conjunction with blood glucose monitoring performed before meals (preprandial) and after meals (postprandial), can assist in optimizing A1C targets. This allows for more accurate and individualized modifications to diabetes treatment plans. For individuals who do not have the ability to use CGM devices on a continuous basis, performing periodic scans of glucose levels can still yield important and actionable information to support effective diabetes management.
